data.title: Fairmont Residences Dubai Skyline
data.about:
Fairmont Residences Dubai Skyline by RSG Group of Companies redefines luxury living in the heart of Sufouh Gardens. Rising 54 storeys high, this prestigious residential and hotel development is a landmark collaboration with Accor, Europe’s largest hospitality group. The tower features 122 exquisitely designed residences, including 2–3 bedroom apartments, 4-bedroom half-floor Sky Mansions, and ultra-exclusive 4-bedroom full-floor Sky Palaces. Each home boasts one or more balconies, with select units offering maid’s rooms, studies, and even media rooms. Residents can choose from five refined layout styles—Opulent, Harmony, Serenity, Regal, and Tranquility Suites—designed to cater to diverse luxury lifestyles.

Every detail of the interiors is crafted by award-winning designer Kristina Zanic, incorporating rich marble, walnut wood, leather accents, and bronze finishes to create a sophisticated ambiance. The building’s iconic asymmetric balconies are beautifully illuminated at night, offering striking visual appeal. Residents enjoy breathtaking views of the sea and Dubai skyline, along with world-class amenities such as the Fairmont Spa, Gold Lounge, Fairmont Fit gym, outdoor pool, gourmet restaurant, and stylish bar and lounge. Fairmont Residences invites discerning buyers into a world where elegance, design, and hospitality converge seamlessly.
